core_obligations: Groupoid: since all 2-arrows are invertible the category of dotted arrows is a groupoid (proof lines 9122-9123)

Automorphisms: the proof writes an automorphism of a dotted arrow as a 2-morphism satisfying two compatibility conditions, the first saying that it defines a point of the relative inertia over the base and the second that this point restricts to the identity over the fraction field (proof lines 9124-9132)

Geometric reformulation: writing the relative inertia pulled back along the arrow as a group algebraic space, the two conditions say exactly that the resulting point becomes trivial after restriction (proof lines 9133-9145)

Conclusion: if the identity section of that group algebraic space is a closed immersion then such a point must be trivial, and the closedness of the identity section is the separatedness of the diagonal by the cited lemma (proof lines 9143-9147)
proof_roadmap: 2-态射可逆 ⇒ 支点箭头范畴是群胚。给出支点箭头 (a,α,β) 的自同构 θ: a → a，两个条件 β = (id_f ⋆ θ)∘β 与 α = α∘(θ ⋆ id_j) 分别意味着 (a,θ) 定义 I_{X/Y} 上一个点、且它在 Spec K 上的限制是单位。
把 I_{X/Y} 沿 a 拉回得群代数空间 G → Spec A，则 θ 给出 G(A) 的点而其在 G(K) 中平凡；若单位截面 e: Spec A → G 是闭浸入则只能 θ = id。由本章引理（Δ_f 分离 ⟺ 单位截面闭浸入）即得结论。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that in the situation of the valuative criterion the category of dotted arrows is a groupoid, and a setoid as soon as the diagonal of the morphism is separated (author lemma at source lines 9114-9119, label lemma-cat-dotted-arrows). The proof (source lines 9121-9148) records that the groupoid statement is immediate from the invertibility of 2-arrows, rewrites an automorphism of a dotted arrow as a point of the relative inertia pulled back along the arrow which becomes trivial over the fraction field, and concludes by the equivalence between separatedness of the diagonal and the closedness of the identity section of that group algebraic space (proof lines 9122-9147). The reformulation of the two compatibility conditions as a point of the pulled back inertia is the content. H2.
